failure_reason: ReferenceError: Cannot access 'mockStore' before initialization — vi.mock factory references a top-level variable (mockStore) that is not yet initialized when vi.mock is hoisted. All 5 test cases in ShareAssistantPopup.test.tsx could not run.
remediation: Wrap mockStore definition inside a vi.hoisted() call (Vitest >=0.31) or inline the mock return value directly in the vi.mock factory without referencing external variables.
